name: snowball-menu
description: Three-level snowball menu with a compact boxed actionbar UI, selection highlight, look-up confirm, look-down back, hub teleport, effects, stats, daily reward and sound toggle.
tests: Throw a snowball: main menu actionbar opens; there is no big title/subtitle.
Look up on item 1: transfer submenu opens.
Look down: returns to main; look down again: closes.
Open item 2 -> item 1: personal stats show name, opens, points, sound state.
Open item 2 -> item 2: daily reward gives 1 point + 4 apples and shows success.
Open item 2 -> item 3: toggles sound and returns to the personal submenu.
Open item 3 -> item 1/2/3: info pages; look down returns, look up closes.
Throw a snowball while in an action page: menu closes.
Two players: each keeps their own selection and page.
notes: All command blocks are always active; the 15x6x9 structure fits one chunk column at 64 200 0 and needs no tickingarea when the spawn chunk is loaded.
UI is plain title/actionbar text with § colors; no camera/inputpermission/fog.
State: sbm 0=closed 1=main 2=sub 3=action; sbsel 0..3; sbpage 1..10; sbg 0=idle / group id.
The setup row is idempotent and runs once per second.
